question: What's the cheapest offer available at any restaurant in Nagercoil right now?
golden_sql: SELECT o.offer_heading, o.offer_price, sd.name FROM offer o JOIN shop_details sd ON sd.id = o.shop_id JOIN shop_address sa ON sa.shop_id = sd.id JOIN subcategories sc ON sc.id = sd.subcategory_id WHERE o.status = 1 AND sd.status = 1 AND sa.is_default = 1 AND sa.city = 'Nagercoil' AND sc.subcategoryname = 'Restaurent' AND o.offer_price = (SELECT MIN(o2.offer_price) FROM offer o2 JOIN shop_details sd2 ON sd2.id = o2.shop_id JOIN shop_address sa2 ON sa2.shop_id = sd2.id JOIN subcategories sc2 ON sc2.id = sd2.subcategory_id WHERE o2.status = 1 AND sd2.status = 1 AND sa2.is_default = 1 AND sa2.city = 'Nagercoil' AND sc2.subcategoryname = 'Restaurent');
